# Results

The numbers behind every figure in [`figures/`](../figures/), and the rasters
they were computed from — 790 tables (2,673,798 rows) and 4185 GeoTIFFs
across 135 countries, 976.2 MB in all.

*This file is generated by `satimg results build`; edit
[`src/satimg/results.py`](../src/satimg/results.py), not this page.*

These are committed while the 8.2 GB behind them is not, so the findings can be
checked, re-analysed or disputed — and, with the clipped rasters here,
**recomputed from scratch** — without downloading the LRCC-DVNL deposit and the
GADM world layer first. Regenerate them with:

```bash
ISOS=$(python -c "from satimg.regions import COUNTRIES as C; print(*C)")
for ISO in $ISOS; do
  satimg lrcc-dvnl extract    --country "$ISO" --levels 0,1,2
  satimg lrcc-dvnl inequality --country "$ISO"
done
satimg results build            # copy into results/
satimg results build --check    # or just report drift, writing nothing
```

GADM 4.1 has no ADM_2 layer for **Libya, Bahrain, Comoros, Kuwait or Qatar**,
so those analyses stop at admin-1 and have no nested three-way Theil split.
That gap is real, not an omission.

## Read this before quoting a number

1. **A lit pixel never dims here — it goes out.** Every decrease in this series
   is a lit → unlit transition, so gradual dimming is invisible and a falling
   Gini is partly imposed. Catastrophic loss, though, is real signal: Syria's
   national sum of lights falls 54% between 2010 and 2016.
2. **2014 is a sensor handover** (DMSP → VIIRS) and a dtype change. Treat any
   2013 → 2014 step as a candidate artefact.
3. **DN is a relative index, not radiance.** A Gini of DN is not a Gini of
   income or output.
4. **`theil_l` is `nan` wherever any value is zero**, which is most
   zeros-included pixel rows. That is the measure being undefined, not a bug.

Full method and the remaining caveats:
[`../docs/arab-world.md`](../docs/arab-world.md).

## Terms

Derived from GADM 4.1 boundaries (unit codes, names, areas, and the national
outline the rasters are masked to) and LRCC-DVNL imagery. Like the figures,
**nothing here is covered by the repository's MIT licence** — GADM is
non-commercial with no redistribution. No GADM geometry is included as
geometry; the `gid`/`name`/`area_km2` columns are the attributes needed to
interpret a row at all, and the rasters carry the boundary only as a 1 km
nodata footprint. See [`../figures/NOTICE.md`](../figures/NOTICE.md).

## Morocco: inequality series

[`MAR/MAR_inequality_series.csv`](MAR/MAR_inequality_series.csv) — 372 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (region), `adm2` (province) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit), `dark` (derived: darkest 2), `dark_wide` (derived: darkest 5) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:6be5fd4761be505156249aa0dae31d94aa46fb518cb6cecad63a7424cacb0304`

## Morocco: Theil decomposition

[`MAR/MAR_theil_decomposition.csv`](MAR/MAR_theil_decomposition.csv) — 1,116 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit), `dark` (derived: darkest 2), `dark_wide` (derived: darkest 5) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `region`, `province`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → province → region split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:81a03ec2e7a8a9a162a185defb3127da9a91555f97005af3a9de728368a67e0f`

## Morocco: per-unit Theil contributions

[`MAR/MAR_theil_by_unit.csv`](MAR/MAR_theil_by_unit.csv) — 10,726 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit), `dark` (derived: darkest 2), `dark_wide` (derived: darkest 5) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `region` or `province` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

`sha256:2708f209abf7a211da26e39f545e93997c708ca733f498be9d367cdc0c2ffdf6`

## Morocco: region aridity

[`MAR/MAR_adm1_aridity.csv`](MAR/MAR_adm1_aridity.csv) — 15 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the region |
| `name` | GADM name of the region |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:72b382a0795492c466c7e3bbe218233135addac61cf5bf9180c86f9d99db289c`

## Morocco: region zonal table

[`MAR/MAR_adm1_zonal.csv`](MAR/MAR_adm1_zonal.csv) — 465 rows

Per-region aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_1` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_1` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:5c50ff612dc56445db993bf64cc358a222fb3012819047825936ebf2ca9a41fb`

## Libya: inequality series

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (district) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit), `dark` (derived: darkest 1), `dark_wide` (derived: darkest 9) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

## Libya: Theil decomposition

[`LBY/LBY_theil_decomposition.csv`](LBY/LBY_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit), `dark` (derived: darkest 1), `dark_wide` (derived: darkest 9) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `district` only; GADM has no admin-2 layer for this country, so there is no `nested` row |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

## Libya: district aridity

[`LBY/LBY_adm1_aridity.csv`](LBY/LBY_adm1_aridity.csv) — 22 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |

## Sudan: state aridity

[`SDN/SDN_adm1_aridity.csv`](SDN/SDN_adm1_aridity.csv) — 18 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the state |
| `name` | GADM name of the state |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |

| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

## Saudi Arabia: inequality series

[`SAU/SAU_inequality_series.csv`](SAU/SAU_inequality_series.csv) — 248 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (province), `adm2` (governorate) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit), `dark` (derived: darkest 5) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the region |
| `name` | GADM name of the region |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:f97ec8712088539df74a08655f1b335e88404da7215ce6bf45a56fe1033aa73f`

## Oman: region zonal table

[`OMN/OMN_adm1_zonal.csv`](OMN/OMN_adm1_zonal.csv) — 341 rows

Per-region aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_1` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_1` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:03cf8c8a4b6ef48e1bbbe2407ac1d0b2b468877594631c9b666cb2949924d877`

## Oman: province zonal table

[`OMN/OMN_adm2_zonal.csv`](OMN/OMN_adm2_zonal.csv) — 1,519 rows

Per-province aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year. **Check `pixels` before trusting a density**: the smallest units cover only a pixel or two, so their densities are extremely noisy. They are kept rather than dropped silently, so the choice is yours and visible.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_2` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_2` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:f62d8b9d301b92931d091f657174066da6ce6c7fbab6a9b9a6ba09a967e607e1`

## United Arab Emirates: inequality series

[`ARE/ARE_inequality_series.csv`](ARE/ARE_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (emirate), `adm2` (district) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:7f48f17e630c2715061a312b9ee6ddb1415436525c54b3996dda6afbf636bd40`

## United Arab Emirates: Theil decomposition

[`ARE/ARE_theil_decomposition.csv`](ARE/ARE_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `emirate`, `district`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → district → emirate split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:170ed4eaae60377a62a834f13351ad59d90fc292729d34eea3bdeeb46ffe3aa3`

## United Arab Emirates: per-unit Theil contributions

[`ARE/ARE_theil_by_unit.csv`](ARE/ARE_theil_by_unit.csv) — 11,408 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `emirate` or `district` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

`sha256:15591cf36b5191b15f2f266dd80ff37423ce302b52e9216cfdfe5fc3e38495f9`

## Kuwait: Theil decomposition

[`KWT/KWT_theil_decomposition.csv`](KWT/KWT_theil_decomposition.csv) — 124 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `province` only; GADM has no admin-2 layer for this country, so there is no `nested` row |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the governorate |
| `name` | GADM name of the governorate |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:3e7845950d240dd4b465f7a0bdc831fdecb7bc903761d834ea7816dd31e7077c`

## Lebanon: governorate zonal table

[`LBN/LBN_adm1_zonal.csv`](LBN/LBN_adm1_zonal.csv) — 248 rows

Per-governorate aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_1` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_1` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:2e44861617b154e94af1fe8c1aeb9c8e866cd2a5d2ae04b638f4b082264989f0`

## Lebanon: district zonal table

[`LBN/LBN_adm2_zonal.csv`](LBN/LBN_adm2_zonal.csv) — 930 rows

Per-district aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year. **Check `pixels` before trusting a density**: the smallest units cover only a pixel or two, so their densities are extremely noisy. They are kept rather than dropped silently, so the choice is yours and visible.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_2` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_2` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:cc4293c276915e18a6d2a3b22cd927a0909179b026b94cd4c5f1aad75f6c2059`

## Jordan: inequality series

[`JOR/JOR_inequality_series.csv`](JOR/JOR_inequality_series.csv) — 372 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (province), `adm2` (sub-province) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit), `dark` (derived: darkest 2), `dark_wide` (derived: darkest 3) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:3549271ee4d33c5f4d5107eb4debe66e380ba31fd93b07e60e9cd5a902953cda`

## Jordan: Theil decomposition

[`JOR/JOR_theil_decomposition.csv`](JOR/JOR_theil_decomposition.csv) — 1,116 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit), `dark` (derived: darkest 2), `dark_wide` (derived: darkest 3) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `province`, `sub-province`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → sub-province → province split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:e74e1563a5ea3c3fc016090bbc90b9fbb8794f46932ea4ea7d551f5dda5c2aec`

## Jordan: per-unit Theil contributions

[`JOR/JOR_theil_by_unit.csv`](JOR/JOR_theil_by_unit.csv) — 10,168 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit), `dark` (derived: darkest 2), `dark_wide` (derived: darkest 3) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `province` or `sub-province` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

`sha256:f3af21b3ac91cf68ba307641f136d21ca3d50c04f9a3fcbbea4d5ac73bc751e7`

| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

## Djibouti: inequality series

[`DJI/DJI_inequality_series.csv`](DJI/DJI_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (region), `adm2` (admin-2 unit) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:52b0fd74633fda9486e9db03baa9431bc1327a4f990e6266251a6473ffec2a53`

## Djibouti: Theil decomposition

[`DJI/DJI_theil_decomposition.csv`](DJI/DJI_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `region`, `admin-2 unit`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → admin-2 unit → region split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:8bf7f47ae79da2621c2a4f741d80ec9395680f55714b92033357afe1c03880d9`

## Djibouti: per-unit Theil contributions

[`DJI/DJI_theil_by_unit.csv`](DJI/DJI_theil_by_unit.csv) — 1,262 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `region` or `admin-2 unit` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |

## Djibouti: region aridity

[`DJI/DJI_adm1_aridity.csv`](DJI/DJI_adm1_aridity.csv) — 6 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the region |
| `name` | GADM name of the region |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:c7865b0d724afdd09e9aade3853ebded751e1d3f31bd64a48f3c08755fef7710`

| `grouping` | `province`, `admin-2 unit`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → admin-2 unit → province split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |

## Angola: province aridity

[`AGO/AGO_adm1_aridity.csv`](AGO/AGO_adm1_aridity.csv) — 18 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the province |
| `name` | GADM name of the province |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:adafcdb59ddf86ad5dd28c7238bf58b015219d3d4e34270c0a6867a4b743b4c3`

## Burundi: inequality series

[`BDI/BDI_inequality_series.csv`](BDI/BDI_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (province), `adm2` (commune) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:9c25559987cafd0c830b31d5fe3fc3fda057ac4a7c55d609e4143855b8d7a9c9`

[`BFA/BFA_adm1_aridity.csv`](BFA/BFA_adm1_aridity.csv) — 13 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the region |
| `name` | GADM name of the region |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:d0f6dd0d3009cd0f42fcb1ef63dc042a0fc14a293e8047800d221b1b21537d39`

## Burkina Faso: region zonal table

[`BFA/BFA_adm1_zonal.csv`](BFA/BFA_adm1_zonal.csv) — 403 rows

Per-region aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_1` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_1` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:0f1f0fbccaae4ad20aa1005d51239aeb73a187304f8f38920017677c66ab2051`

| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

## Botswana: inequality series

[`BWA/BWA_inequality_series.csv`](BWA/BWA_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (district), `adm2` (sub-district) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:6845b3e89bdbcd1d8bc12b689c863fb386a3f556313998e1557a0c4286f59182`

## Botswana: Theil decomposition

[`BWA/BWA_theil_decomposition.csv`](BWA/BWA_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `district`, `sub-district`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → sub-district → district split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:cfee5f06169c0c159ee045048ff3d83df154e5c9f525ba3189a920442d2401cf`

## Botswana: per-unit Theil contributions

[`BWA/BWA_theil_by_unit.csv`](BWA/BWA_theil_by_unit.csv) — 2,814 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `district` or `sub-district` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

`sha256:069af86bdaa1d05c48fc47fde67977f186a467f435c8b881100bca37898a33e0`

## Cameroon: inequality series

[`CMR/CMR_inequality_series.csv`](CMR/CMR_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (region), `adm2` (department) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:98491cf816333a07cd0db5a2e99e13170a83566c779766ad0825db771b49c563`

## Cameroon: Theil decomposition

[`CMR/CMR_theil_decomposition.csv`](CMR/CMR_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `region`, `department`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → department → region split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:c4bb94d43e52842a75929233e9e7a949903f9f198feb9eb6ca2ef926ac7340f8`

## Cameroon: per-unit Theil contributions

[`CMR/CMR_theil_by_unit.csv`](CMR/CMR_theil_by_unit.csv) — 3,894 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `region` or `department` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

## Cameroon: region aridity

[`CMR/CMR_adm1_aridity.csv`](CMR/CMR_adm1_aridity.csv) — 10 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the region |
| `name` | GADM name of the region |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:e7ffd90408d541c86398fe00f944cee70d6c420e9c37a1823958b0efddf5adcf`

## Cabo Verde: Theil decomposition

[`CPV/CPV_theil_decomposition.csv`](CPV/CPV_theil_decomposition.csv) — 124 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `county` only; GADM has no admin-2 layer for this country, so there is no `nested` row |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

## Cabo Verde: county aridity

[`CPV/CPV_adm1_aridity.csv`](CPV/CPV_adm1_aridity.csv) — 22 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the county |
| `name` | GADM name of the county |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

## Gabon: inequality series

[`GAB/GAB_inequality_series.csv`](GAB/GAB_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (province), `adm2` (department) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:57203b398b051ccb87fc17a3b3ef9ce5c02b220517e8a24b5f83958165b2a52e`

## Gabon: Theil decomposition

[`GAB/GAB_theil_decomposition.csv`](GAB/GAB_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `province`, `department`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → department → province split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:d0a8363095e591d4e75912d9b75145ff38f5be527d6527b90fe9ef3883c91d0e`

## Gabon: per-unit Theil contributions

[`GAB/GAB_theil_by_unit.csv`](GAB/GAB_theil_by_unit.csv) — 2,650 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `province` or `department` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

`sha256:243c4650c04d9d2a569c871fef5d84251f2d8fc63ffadc113210190fda445d87`

## Gabon: province aridity

[`GAB/GAB_adm1_aridity.csv`](GAB/GAB_adm1_aridity.csv) — 9 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the province |
| `name` | GADM name of the province |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:61c8ae38f604b0c64b5f31e4ec642669ec4e1f4b36482ee0f211d9179bc86e19`

[`GMB/GMB_inequality_series.csv`](GMB/GMB_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (division), `adm2` (district) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:150c1a58ba58dd1ba2114ffaf898b2bd28f5022f61225cca0aa8baa897698139`

## Gambia: Theil decomposition

[`GMB/GMB_theil_decomposition.csv`](GMB/GMB_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `division`, `district`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → district → division split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:2007cdd38fc701f035f979baa51cc38b4691d56f987b012c348964ecaee8d9a3`

## Gambia: per-unit Theil contributions

[`GMB/GMB_theil_by_unit.csv`](GMB/GMB_theil_by_unit.csv) — 1,982 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `division` or `district` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

`sha256:95119283493611fc9446fbeb26b4690f19e89963368d69a28e2f5fcabafb9126`

## Gambia: division aridity

[`GMB/GMB_adm1_aridity.csv`](GMB/GMB_adm1_aridity.csv) — 6 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the division |
| `name` | GADM name of the division |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:2b9a2965bc90dcbf320edf64627c54410467f3524a012556cd18ac9e03259476`

## Gambia: division zonal table

[`GMB/GMB_adm1_zonal.csv`](GMB/GMB_adm1_zonal.csv) — 186 rows

Per-division aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_1` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_1` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:00db0bb32f9bd0c944a3b8de6433f3702ee1e0e8eeb2c21b4f42eec8a9a2c126`

| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

[`LBR/LBR_inequality_series.csv`](LBR/LBR_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (county), `adm2` (district) |

| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |

| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

Per-admin-1 unit aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_1` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_1` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:c2f74e2f2dd122fed028eb67941614c2aff6b41b3c49a36b804c2047d33e274a`

## Madagascar: admin-2 unit zonal table

[`MDG/MDG_adm2_zonal.csv`](MDG/MDG_adm2_zonal.csv) — 682 rows

Per-admin-2 unit aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year. **Check `pixels` before trusting a density**: the smallest units cover only a pixel or two, so their densities are extremely noisy. They are kept rather than dropped silently, so the choice is yours and visible.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_2` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_2` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:3f5657b760cae1efc732db6b3b86ed63abfcbfa765c76fcabfc7131b6da5e021`

## Mali: inequality series

[`MLI/MLI_inequality_series.csv`](MLI/MLI_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (region), `adm2` (circle) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:661297c4355da4247a24f0cb7be46626bbe6def09de955bf631f6142c866fdb8`

## Mali: Theil decomposition

[`MLI/MLI_theil_decomposition.csv`](MLI/MLI_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `region`, `circle`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → circle → region split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:9ffd582ec4ad1b6eb6bcee7f2a251bb7998e9a294ff98e2be98cde77676e0472`

## Mali: per-unit Theil contributions

[`MLI/MLI_theil_by_unit.csv`](MLI/MLI_theil_by_unit.csv) — 3,178 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `region` or `circle` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

`sha256:7ba507ff377d9d536280c3a53af5162195bc552cee64c2096ad6859e82f0ce97`

## Mali: region aridity

[`MLI/MLI_adm1_aridity.csv`](MLI/MLI_adm1_aridity.csv) — 9 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the region |
| `name` | GADM name of the region |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:b0761dce5c239952258bdceb6d9f21694567da2964962ecbdf5ef82a4d4be61d`

[`MWI/MWI_theil_decomposition.csv`](MWI/MWI_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `district`, `traditional authority`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → traditional authority → district split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:5bb9d8446707251635e03f67ef806ea0b5b75aeed80ec7ccc66636d935673954`

## Malawi: per-unit Theil contributions

[`MWI/MWI_theil_by_unit.csv`](MWI/MWI_theil_by_unit.csv) — 13,850 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `district` or `traditional authority` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

`sha256:6cccf3afa26fc337018e49f8e43829aa9fef309166873bc9daf838cf2b5dded2`

## Malawi: district aridity

[`MWI/MWI_adm1_aridity.csv`](MWI/MWI_adm1_aridity.csv) — 28 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the district |
| `name` | GADM name of the district |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:9338eec1096ba854ec1cf47ddfd076bbeddb5af6c3eb3941a157818a78bd9b5d`

## Malawi: district zonal table

[`MWI/MWI_adm1_zonal.csv`](MWI/MWI_adm1_zonal.csv) — 868 rows

Per-district aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_1` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_1` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:e8eac4ea3a280c201cbd5b03e6c77cc20073f4660825c71fdd4f6492e8a54652`

| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

## Namibia: inequality series

[`NAM/NAM_inequality_series.csv`](NAM/NAM_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (region), `adm2` (constituency) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:b2a279bf1461a77d82569f2746a4594ba0cae20079ddbc22e2eedc5c35e34af7`

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

## Rwanda: inequality series

[`RWA/RWA_inequality_series.csv`](RWA/RWA_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (province), `adm2` (district) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:5ca9cb9c1fb86944b17e932a167d517822157ca16dd6ab7de3117d14258b2b94`

## Rwanda: Theil decomposition

[`RWA/RWA_theil_decomposition.csv`](RWA/RWA_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `province`, `district`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → district → province split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:248485aee663304b2451671d1bd8715a35466877596678de71068c84ed33d01a`

| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |
