## South Sudan: inequality series

[`SSD/SSD_inequality_series.csv`](SSD/SSD_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (state), `adm2` (district) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:4b9d6c6a7984b9a6da72a94f852b71ca80e1a29a6d82d5702232660b3a3bfac7`

## South Sudan: Theil decomposition

[`SSD/SSD_theil_decomposition.csv`](SSD/SSD_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `state`, `district`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → district → state split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:18d0bfa09e29dc0048602d1ebefadd6f7cd718a7794bc2a8c7b599ef31d3026a`

## South Sudan: per-unit Theil contributions

[`SSD/SSD_theil_by_unit.csv`](SSD/SSD_theil_by_unit.csv) — 2,392 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `state` or `district` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

## South Sudan: state aridity

[`SSD/SSD_adm1_aridity.csv`](SSD/SSD_adm1_aridity.csv) — 10 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the state |
| `name` | GADM name of the state |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:8dca7a4ddb39bb59bf0f7bdc9e0050179a61e0ef7eac317baabc5f09bb4e8ff2`

| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (district) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

## Seychelles: Theil decomposition

[`SYC/SYC_theil_decomposition.csv`](SYC/SYC_theil_decomposition.csv) — 124 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `district` only; GADM has no admin-2 layer for this country, so there is no `nested` row |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:889152fad3df2597902f676de887114c8c32d48ddece6b3143a00c3b1ac27eba`

## Seychelles: district aridity

[`SYC/SYC_adm1_aridity.csv`](SYC/SYC_adm1_aridity.csv) — 26 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the district |
| `name` | GADM name of the district |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the region |
| `name` | GADM name of the region |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:6e1ca1671638d0b49a89e3156db93e6aee29600c240f4b80d5c2b458aba69e5c`

## Tanzania: region zonal table

[`TZA/TZA_adm1_zonal.csv`](TZA/TZA_adm1_zonal.csv) — 961 rows

Per-region aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_1` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_1` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:9cd3cc112a33f9aa0ad7823ea00376c5e2d0b7da7c910bc89e8c26d1842c8e94`

## Tanzania: district zonal table

[`TZA/TZA_adm2_zonal.csv`](TZA/TZA_adm2_zonal.csv) — 5,766 rows

Per-district aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year. **Check `pixels` before trusting a density**: the smallest units cover only a pixel or two, so their densities are extremely noisy. They are kept rather than dropped silently, so the choice is yours and visible.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_2` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_2` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:05f64e968c6a9cda6c2af0d9aaf52439af3496498b8ad32476a25530f54f1694`

## Uganda: inequality series

[`UGA/UGA_inequality_series.csv`](UGA/UGA_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (district), `adm2` (county) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:885e3745a41c85f53f633c18f4d35e0a9aaf3450b10a0cbd97ae3ebefcdd2a4c`

## Uganda: Theil decomposition

[`UGA/UGA_theil_decomposition.csv`](UGA/UGA_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `district`, `county`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → county → district split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:9290a4f6a6415a396c2eb7aedec0ca74a1085ea202324ffc161294d3e5bffcfe`

## Uganda: per-unit Theil contributions

[`UGA/UGA_theil_by_unit.csv`](UGA/UGA_theil_by_unit.csv) — 10,262 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `district` or `county` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

`sha256:8c02e1ad658a424964a03e9371e7c79f3ac6d665a8e22a2d93ceb0191159e8a7`

| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

## Zimbabwe: inequality series

[`ZWE/ZWE_inequality_series.csv`](ZWE/ZWE_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (province), `adm2` (district) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:de54175e55cc0aee5deb66d54acc5c91e0da4b62622eb8362d679f44953f7169`

## Zimbabwe: Theil decomposition

[`ZWE/ZWE_theil_decomposition.csv`](ZWE/ZWE_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `province`, `district`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → district → province split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:89ab8f24377724a551f81b60855d585f0da9daa29da568945c57b5f80fb27fed`

## Zimbabwe: per-unit Theil contributions

[`ZWE/ZWE_theil_by_unit.csv`](ZWE/ZWE_theil_by_unit.csv) — 6,152 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `province` or `district` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

## Zimbabwe: province aridity

[`ZWE/ZWE_adm1_aridity.csv`](ZWE/ZWE_adm1_aridity.csv) — 10 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the province |
| `name` | GADM name of the province |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:a8a19309e2ced5e303aa8545a3211e4a121901c3ff34255346b06a4f7991cc57`

| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |

| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

## Mexico: Theil decomposition

[`MEX/MEX_theil_decomposition.csv`](MEX/MEX_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `state`, `municipality`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → municipality → state split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:964ca191229a18d159744a51d98a2f4ce068dc7c151aee9623a10540abe33ab6`

## Mexico: state aridity

[`MEX/MEX_adm1_aridity.csv`](MEX/MEX_adm1_aridity.csv) — 32 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the state |
| `name` | GADM name of the state |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:d4bd450f9deae3a17e59aae6da303594377d0bf14c037fc4561a2ee86a9ecc74`

## Guatemala: inequality series

[`GTM/GTM_inequality_series.csv`](GTM/GTM_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (department), `adm2` (municipality) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:8d1a68a71db1adac13dde933633faf67a243494873a55afa88245adb68966ee7`

## Guatemala: Theil decomposition

[`GTM/GTM_theil_decomposition.csv`](GTM/GTM_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `department`, `municipality`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → municipality → department split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:24ea574e5c687aeb978f44782414c5d6aa62c351e32f5091c7de3323a2640474`

## Guatemala: per-unit Theil contributions

[`GTM/GTM_theil_by_unit.csv`](GTM/GTM_theil_by_unit.csv) — 22,914 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `department` or `municipality` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

Per-municipality aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year. **Check `pixels` before trusting a density**: the smallest units cover only a pixel or two, so their densities are extremely noisy. They are kept rather than dropped silently, so the choice is yours and visible.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_2` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_2` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

`sha256:35c57aca5381ec793f36ca5dc52e347af2218b8ecdefcb6569ccb59a1e86e69a`

## Panama: inequality series

[`PAN/PAN_inequality_series.csv`](PAN/PAN_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (province), `adm2` (district) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:c856e041d135753829898d10ecf42d9a1e1a7759f3b61676b9e1deca062aefca`

## Panama: Theil decomposition

[`PAN/PAN_theil_decomposition.csv`](PAN/PAN_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `province`, `district`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → district → province split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:8a821d231376a342c49adbd9d15a72fe3e4739096a56894759a1b8547f43cb36`

## Panama: per-unit Theil contributions

[`PAN/PAN_theil_by_unit.csv`](PAN/PAN_theil_by_unit.csv) — 5,313 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `province` or `district` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

`sha256:aedf2aaeadc2b5b308770f57d92ddbae532b74278cc56c7b98cca338997c6dab`

## Panama: province aridity

[`PAN/PAN_adm1_aridity.csv`](PAN/PAN_adm1_aridity.csv) — 13 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the province |
| `name` | GADM name of the province |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:686235862d957145a80f8a821c102b6360e6afd8906806d44eb82ded5c46cedd`

## Cuba: inequality series

[`CUB/CUB_inequality_series.csv`](CUB/CUB_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (province), `adm2` (municipality) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:20e50ed8a7de60b810c2e546b9d9e0ecb2a207a92a513839ab20d109303101c9`

## Cuba: Theil decomposition

[`CUB/CUB_theil_decomposition.csv`](CUB/CUB_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `province`, `municipality`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → municipality → province split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:1e4a13b91cb28341f7d752f0a44e3ade4185090a94685e39bd3975c4e006c020`

| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |

## Grenada: Theil decomposition

[`GRD/GRD_theil_decomposition.csv`](GRD/GRD_theil_decomposition.csv) — 124 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `parish` only; GADM has no admin-2 layer for this country, so there is no `nested` row |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:65b19196fdcb1126b73b5462236161e81e48a2af45e8c4b6873010d35ce379fd`

## Grenada: parish aridity

[`GRD/GRD_adm1_aridity.csv`](GRD/GRD_adm1_aridity.csv) — 7 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the parish |
| `name` | GADM name of the parish |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

## Saint Lucia: inequality series

[`LCA/LCA_inequality_series.csv`](LCA/LCA_inequality_series.csv) — 93 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (quarter) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

## Saint Lucia: Theil decomposition

[`LCA/LCA_theil_decomposition.csv`](LCA/LCA_theil_decomposition.csv) — 124 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `quarter` only; GADM has no admin-2 layer for this country, so there is no `nested` row |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:c1df4726b86d73dd4c1cee2c7f18cdca1398f83a510fc425d941cad257e4f268`

## Saint Lucia: quarter aridity

[`LCA/LCA_adm1_aridity.csv`](LCA/LCA_adm1_aridity.csv) — 10 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |

| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |

## Bolivia: inequality series

[`BOL/BOL_inequality_series.csv`](BOL/BOL_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (department), `adm2` (province) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:c1727f7c734feb053bac08c45bf0e3430480999602ee39da357d8e67d7ca0284`

## Bolivia: Theil decomposition

[`BOL/BOL_theil_decomposition.csv`](BOL/BOL_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `department`, `province`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → province → department split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:df2e414492e7eac13ebfcdfd4e62da6297f4fb2178a283a41d0c7ecc6e95161e`

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |

| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |

| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:cf0c7c2e4c702825dde45e50c09df2bfe748bd0a8c69c033c5b936b88db06e31`

## Colombia: Theil decomposition

[`COL/COL_theil_decomposition.csv`](COL/COL_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `department`, `municipality`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → municipality → department split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:11830b94d4c8bfdf38087a71ca79ec35502b47a3d3e701a3d5274c152e1d63d1`

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |

| `grouping` | `department` or `municipality` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |

## Colombia: department aridity

[`COL/COL_adm1_aridity.csv`](COL/COL_adm1_aridity.csv) — 33 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the department |
| `name` | GADM name of the department |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:c5bfb9ff47e76749e45774f46f2583394be5694236e47699afb41e36a2ef4e5d`

[`PRY/PRY_theil_by_unit.csv`](PRY/PRY_theil_by_unit.csv) — 14,177 rows

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `department` or `district` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

## Paraguay: department aridity

[`PRY/PRY_adm1_aridity.csv`](PRY/PRY_adm1_aridity.csv) — 18 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the department |
| `name` | GADM name of the department |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:a6a7949ec1670196b86715d548eef8b0dc40a764e25de252d624e0628f19bcd6`

## Paraguay: department zonal table

[`PRY/PRY_adm1_zonal.csv`](PRY/PRY_adm1_zonal.csv) — 558 rows

Per-department aggregation, the basis of every subnational number above. Each land pixel belongs to exactly one unit, so `sum_of_lights` totals to the national figure for every year.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `gid` | GADM `GID_1` code — stable across releases, unlike names |
| `name` | GADM `NAME_1` |
| `pixels` | land pixels assigned to the unit |
| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

| `area_km2` | unit area from the GADM geometry, in EPSG:8857 |
| `sum_of_lights` | Σ DN over the unit's pixels |
| `mean_dn` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `pixels` |
| `density_sol_per_km2` | `sum_of_lights` ÷ `area_km2` — the quantity the subnational Gini and Theil are computed over |

## Peru: inequality series

[`PER/PER_inequality_series.csv`](PER/PER_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (region), `adm2` (province) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:530cd468b728930e4579f5a5afd18ebefc3d4b3acb567138ddd0c31c2f204cef`

## Peru: Theil decomposition

[`PER/PER_theil_decomposition.csv`](PER/PER_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `region`, `province`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → province → region split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:3b2699959b84b8089c059073ba6421fef215636844be9f98139673aa3e7ef1a5`

## Venezuela: inequality series

[`VEN/VEN_inequality_series.csv`](VEN/VEN_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (state), `adm2` (municipality) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:d4cfa0b273dc6778f2674fbb4b132a6b698504e5fe3158ade90731a9bf0c90de`

## Venezuela: Theil decomposition

[`VEN/VEN_theil_decomposition.csv`](VEN/VEN_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `state`, `municipality`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → municipality → state split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:ddc1629f0be43d7f5af577cfc384f6be4298ca17dc6fb05920058727cfb2c3ed`

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `grouping` | `state` or `municipality` |
| `unit` | unit name |
| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |
| `population_share` | the unit's share of pixels |
| `value_share` | the unit's share of total light |
| `theil_t` | Theil T computed within the unit alone |
| `within_contribution` | the unit's term in the within component: `value_share` × its own `theil_t`. These sum to `within` in the decomposition |

| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |

| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

## Austria: Theil decomposition

[`AUT/AUT_theil_decomposition.csv`](AUT/AUT_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `state`, `district`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → district → state split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:9af9a81deb992e8c214b65b2f412d0e824254e829d607c739f62fbfbdce81327`

|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |

| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |

## Austria: state aridity

[`AUT/AUT_adm1_aridity.csv`](AUT/AUT_adm1_aridity.csv) — 9 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the state |
| `name` | GADM name of the state |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:0e3098088d00aaed3093832145413f665dd7a7a2e3f9f4bdbbb738c1f0fae1a9`

## Bosnia and Herzegovina: entity aridity

[`BIH/BIH_adm1_aridity.csv`](BIH/BIH_adm1_aridity.csv) — 3 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |

| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the entity |

| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |

| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

## Bulgaria: inequality series

[`BGR/BGR_inequality_series.csv`](BGR/BGR_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (province), `adm2` (municipality) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:0e47154e68e46efba5f1c00c2fb7df4e78c24a8e88cfc9aa573b74a9e18f8604`

## Bulgaria: Theil decomposition

[`BGR/BGR_theil_decomposition.csv`](BGR/BGR_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `province`, `municipality`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → municipality → province split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:44430389f51212e7e724d871cf3ecb653b8772599cb3bdd19bf9dc1efbf6fe96`

## Czechia: inequality series

[`CZE/CZE_inequality_series.csv`](CZE/CZE_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (region), `adm2` (district) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:f675e979a640ecef18ca55406b652f836dc5e62427dcdc8a81ff740a65c79960`

## Czechia: Theil decomposition

[`CZE/CZE_theil_decomposition.csv`](CZE/CZE_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `region`, `district`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → district → region split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:b666a8f0b4c4aff1b57ef3a825ac35cb673715b9f45d2bc8aff020945414e139`

What each unit contributes to the total, for Theil T. The table that answers *which* unit drives a movement in the headline series.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |

| `pixels` | land pixels in the unit, within scope |
| `mean_dn` | mean DN over those pixels |

## Czechia: region aridity

[`CZE/CZE_adm1_aridity.csv`](CZE/CZE_adm1_aridity.csv) — 14 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the region |
| `name` | GADM name of the region |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:ff2a3aad35ee485c6228c1472fc93ba514ab1daa06d20382b550d998b1333708`

## Hungary: Theil decomposition

[`HUN/HUN_theil_decomposition.csv`](HUN/HUN_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `county`, `subregion`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → subregion → county split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:4e8c85fcf027d2e95ac2fed38299646087acec7a4b6066b8f8986bbaafc86301`

## Hungary: county aridity

[`HUN/HUN_adm1_aridity.csv`](HUN/HUN_adm1_aridity.csv) — 20 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the county |
| `name` | GADM name of the county |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

## Iceland: inequality series

[`ISL/ISL_inequality_series.csv`](ISL/ISL_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (region), `adm2` (municipality) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:333cd27f3d53e1c14d29ee25934d5b83535f8faa857879ae0146bb7fbb6872e1`

## Liechtenstein: inequality series

[`LIE/LIE_inequality_series.csv`](LIE/LIE_inequality_series.csv) — 93 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (commune) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:5f85827ec4981b2398e4e43ea98e28708be4e78777b57467a4b9edb9e298901d`

## Liechtenstein: Theil decomposition

[`LIE/LIE_theil_decomposition.csv`](LIE/LIE_theil_decomposition.csv) — 124 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `commune` only; GADM has no admin-2 layer for this country, so there is no `nested` row |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:1aab8ece9fabed1023507cda878510f9ca999a08f95c6e8a0fe8dc637985048d`

## Malta: inequality series

[`MLT/MLT_inequality_series.csv`](MLT/MLT_inequality_series.csv) — 124 rows

The headline result. Pixel-level rows are the distribution of DN over land pixels; subnational rows are the distribution of **light density** (SOL/km²) over units, unweighted, so a large unit does not score high merely for being large.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `level` | `pixel`, `adm1` (region), `adm2` (local council) |
| `level_label` | human-readable form of `level` |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `n` | observations behind the index: pixels, or units |
| `gini` | Gini coefficient; `nan` if the distribution is all-zero |
| `theil_t` | Theil T = GE(1); maximum is ln(n) |
| `theil_l` | Theil L = GE(0); `nan` whenever any value is 0, since ln(μ/x) diverges — which is why the zeros-included pixel rows are undefined rather than large |
| `sum_of_lights` | total DN over the scope, for reference |
| `lit_share` | fraction of land pixels with DN > 0; pixel rows only |

`sha256:c2e3681e5a1d04732dc1c6cae1a36c16ddf8a2be96c86d9c02fb53c9df42cf68`

## Malta: Theil decomposition

[`MLT/MLT_theil_decomposition.csv`](MLT/MLT_theil_decomposition.csv) — 372 rows

Additive between/within splits of pixel-level Theil. `residual` is the identity check: it stays at machine precision on every defined row, so the split is exact rather than approximate.

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `year` | calendar year, 1992–2022 |
| `scope` | unit set — `all` (every unit) |
| `zeros` | pixel zero treatment: `zeros_included` (all land pixels) or `lit_only` (DN > 0). Blank for subnational rows, where the unit is the observation |
| `measure` | `theil_t` or `theil_l` |
| `grouping` | `region`, `local council`, or `nested` — the three-way pixel → local council → region split |
| `total` | the index over all pixels in scope |
| `between` | between-group component |
| `within` | within-group component |
| `between_share` | `between` ÷ `total` |
| `within_share` | `within` ÷ `total` |
| `between_deleg_within_gov` | the middle term of the nested split: variation between admin-2 units of the same admin-1 unit. `nan` otherwise |
| `residual` | |total − (between + within)|; a correctness check |
| `n_groups` | groups with at least one pixel in scope |

`sha256:e6601ec52bff450367c7a503174b1ed21386e46f50913fa55b61987e8ba6036c`

## Malta: region aridity

[`MLT/MLT_adm1_aridity.csv`](MLT/MLT_adm1_aridity.csv) — 5 rows

Climate, measured independently of light. Each unit's share of the five UNEP aridity classes from the Global Aridity Index v3.1, on true cell areas rather than pixel counts. This is what the light-derived exclusion scopes are checked against in [`../docs/aridity.md`](../docs/aridity.md).

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `iso3` | ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code |
| `gid` | GADM identifier of the region |
| `name` | GADM name of the region |
| `area_km2` | unit area on the WGS 84 ellipsoid |
| `pixels_total` | aridity cells falling in the unit |
| `pixels_classified` | cells carrying a real aridity value; the rest are ocean or permanent ice, and are excluded from every share below |
| `pixels_unclassified` | `pixels_total` − `pixels_classified` |
| `hyper_arid_share` | area share with aridity index < 0.03 |
| `arid_share` | 0.03 ≤ AI < 0.20 |
| `semi_arid_share` | 0.20 ≤ AI < 0.50 |
| `dry_subhumid_share` | 0.50 ≤ AI < 0.65 |
| `humid_share` | AI ≥ 0.65 |
| `desert_share` | `hyper_arid_share` + `arid_share` — the UNEP definition of desert |
| `dryland_share` | everything below AI 0.65, i.e. 1 − `humid_share` |
| `level` | admin level the row describes; always `adm1` here |

`sha256:16dabc2a20bfefb69f131a812c4be09e027c929f20d811263655f84f17630020`
